release_notes: Fixed a Network window startup issue where the callsign prompt could appear before the Network loading screen, and allowed users to keep the default placeholder callsign if desired.
Fixed a bug where the main Morse practice could be started by key presses while Koch receive-practice mode was active.

Improved adaptive decoding by preventing learned spacing from drifting too far from normal Morse timing, which could previously trap users in a loop where overly long learned gaps forced progressively longer spacing.
Reduced the default recent-round analysis window to the last 300 rounds for faster and more practical history, problem character, effective WPM and skill calculations.
